headline: Knocklem Guide
title: Knocklem | Steel Guardian Mode and Heavy Mining | Palworld Guide
video_script: Knocklem is a Ground Pal built like a tank. Its partner skill, Steel Guardian Mode, boosts its own attack and defense for a limited time, from fifty up to two hundred percent depending on its rank. At the base it works at Mining level seven, Transporting level seven and Gathering level four. Will you make one a tank? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Knocklem guide: Ground Pal, Steel Guardian Mode, Mining 7, Transporting 7 and Gathering 4.
joke: Knocklem works hard and also looks like it could win an argument with a wall.
